summary: BMI 44 with untreated moderate OSA for EGD plus colonoscopy under propofol MAC, on tirzepatide (last dose 3 days ago) with worsening fullness and regurgitation, and the GI med list never mentions it.

asa.rationale: BMI over 40, untreated OSA, T2DM, HTN.

decision.recommendation: do not proceed with unprotected deep sedation
decision.rationale: Active GI symptoms on a GLP-1/GIP agonist mean a likely full stomach. Either convert to GA with RSI and an ETT or postpone with the drug held per current guidance.

redFlags.finding: Tirzepatide with symptoms of delayed gastric emptying
redFlags.evidence: Weekly tirzepatide 10 mg, last 10/24; 10/25 message: full after a few bites, food sits, burping at night; queasy today and burped up prep; not on GI med list.
redFlags.implication: Aspiration risk under propofol, especially with an upper endoscopy.
redFlags.action: RSI with ETT (or gastric ultrasound to decide) or postpone; update med list.

redFlags.finding: Untreated moderate OSA, BMI 44, neck 49 cm, prior PACU hypoxemia
redFlags.evidence: AHI 28, nadir 79%, CPAP returned; 2011 needed face mask for an hour.
redFlags.implication: Obstruction and desaturation under deep sedation in lateral position.
redFlags.action: If sedation: HFNC or nasal airway, capnography, experienced airway backup; GA may be safer.

redFlags.finding: ACE inhibitor angioedema, now on losartan
redFlags.implication: Small risk of angioedema with ARBs; airway awareness.

planItems.item: GA with RSI and ETT for the upper endoscopy
